setting.text: An industrial city, home to one of the largest steelworks in the world and crowded with labourers.
Xbox's write-up describes it as a hub for crime and vice: drinking, gambling and prostitution.

story.text: Orpheus's ship lands here, and Makoto and Yu Shinjo begin their lives in Japan.
Makoto finds his work in the criminal underworld, while Yu takes an ordinary job.

activities.text: Arm-wrestling, dice games and card games are the pastimes named for this era.
The achievement list names warehouse security missions that belong to Act 1.

setting.text: Home to Japan's largest naval shipyard, and a city under the heavy influence of organised crime.
A place of shipbuilding and heavy industry with a mix of foreign visitors.

story.text: Makoto is now established among the yakuza as a member of the Iwaki Family, the strongest organisation in Hiroshima.
He is known here as the Red Oni.

activities.text: The achievement list names street fighting against 10 opponents in Act 2.

setting.text: Minami is the largest entertainment district in western Japan, shown here against rising tension around the world.
The yakuza and the Italian Mafia compete for it out of sight.

story.text: Makoto and Yu are reunited, and this is where their show business work takes place.

activities.text: Target shooting is the pastime named for this era.
The achievement list names three black markets to invest in during Act 3.

setting.text: A resort town that became a byword for tourism in postwar Japan.
Less urban than the other cities, known for cherry blossoms and views, with American influence showing in language, music and fashion.

story.text: The singer Suzy Day is introduced in this part of the story.

activities.text: The achievement list names underground fight matches in Act 4.

setting.text: One of the best-known entertainment districts in Japan, shown as a city alive with chaos and energy.
The district is Kamurocho, the fictional quarter of Shinjuku that Like a Dragon players already know.

story.text: The story ends here. Studio head Masayoshi Yokoyama has said a major secret is revealed in this act.

activities.text: The achievement list has no act-specific job for Act 5, unlike the four acts before it.
